template: Create a {quality} POWERFARM image of {subject} in {environment}, {action}. Compose it using {composition}. Use {lighting}. Preserve {realism}. Keep the palette {palette}. {negative}. Intended for {use}.

defaults.quality: credible, premium, cinematic but physically realistic
defaults.composition: strong geometry, one clear focal point, and useful negative space
defaults.lighting: directional natural or practical industrial light with controlled contrast
defaults.realism: believable materials, equipment geometry, scale, wear, reflections, and interfaces
defaults.palette: deep charcoal, steel gray, warm neutral materials, with restrained amber accents
defaults.negative: Avoid stock-photo posing, cyberpunk color, fantasy electricity, excessive glow, impossible equipment, fake interfaces, and oversaturation
